issue: deleteCacheHandler throws a generic Error instead of TRPCError, which surfaces as an internal error and loses intended semantics (not found vs access denied). Should throw TRPCError with appropriate code (NOT_FOUND or UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN)
New getCacheStatusByCredentialIds behavior isn't covered by tests. Should add Vitest tests for this method (e.g. returns max updatedAt per credential and ignores credentials with no cache rows)

Calling SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(..., {}) is a no-op and will not update SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. Need to update at least one field (e.g. set updatedAt explicitly) to accomplish the touch intent
The autogenerated migration header says updatedAt was added without a default value, but the actual SQL adds DEFAULT NOW(). This mismatch is confusing for future maintainers

disableConnectionModification only blocks disconnect but still allows deleting cached data. If flag is meant to prevent all credential modifications, cache delete action should also be disabled/hidden when disableConnectionModification is true
Cache timestamp is formatted with hard-coded locale (en-US) ignoring user's current locale. Should use locale from useLocale() or pass undefined to use browser/user locale

connectedCalendarsHandler instantiates CalendarCacheRepository directly, bypassing the calendar-cache feature-flag behavior. If feature is disabled globally, this will still query and expose cache timestamps and add unnecessary DB load
CalendarCacheRepositoryMock.getCacheStatusByCredentialIds should accept the same credentialIds: number[] parameter as the interface to keep signature aligned

ENV_FILE is set as a relative path from current working directory, not from script location. If run from repo root, it will point to parent directory and update wrong file. Should derive from $(dirname "$0")
The sed -i '' -E invocation is BSD/macOS-specific and will fail on GNU sed (Linux). Script should detect OS and use appropriate sed -i form for cross-platform compatibility

Switching to npx tsx makes script depend on tsx being available via npm at runtime, but tsx is not listed in package dependencies. May fetch from network and break offline or in restricted environments

updateManyByCredentialId takes Prisma.SelectedCalendarUpdateInput but is passed to prisma.selectedCalendar.updateMany which expects update-many mutation input. Should use SelectedCalendarUpdateManyMutationInput

deleteCacheMutation doesn't invalidate any queries. If onSuccess is not provided, UI will keep showing old cacheUpdatedAt until refresh. Should invalidate viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars in onSettled
